map.由动压差求流速: Find the Velocity from the Dynamic Pressure Difference
map.输入动压差 ΔP 与密度 ρ，求流速。: Enter the dynamic pressure difference ΔP and the density ρ to find the velocity.
map.由压差测流速: Measuring velocity from a pressure difference
map.v = sqrt(2*Δp/rho)。例：Δp=6000 Pa、空气 rho=1: v = sqrt(2*Δp/rho). Example: with Δp=6000 Pa and air rho=1.2, v=sqrt(12000/1.2)=100 m/s.
map.总压减静压等于动压，由动压反推速度。: Total pressure minus static pressure equals the dynamic pressure, from which the velocity is derived.
map.飞机空速管、风洞、烟道测速。: Aircraft airspeed tubes, wind tunnels and flue velocity measurement.
